eventConfig.title: ONYX GLOW — Inaugural Heritage Presentation
eventConfig.description: An expression of Nepali heritage, a new vision of women's fashion and the beginning of something special. Join us as ONYX GLOW introduces its identity to the world.

siteContent.announcementBanner: INAUGURAL COLLECTION — PROUDLY MADE IN NEPAL
siteContent.heroStatement: Where traditional Nepali texture meets contemporary women's fashion.
siteContent.brandIntroHeading: MORE THAN FASHION. A CULTURAL IDENTITY.
siteContent.brandIntroText: Born from the beauty of Nepal, ONYX GLOW brings traditional craftsmanship and contemporary women's fashion together. Our identity is deeply connected to Nepali culture, textile heritage and the unique artistry of Dhaka fabric.
siteContent.comingSoonText: Rooted in heritage. Created for the future.
